ctx.x: Hide was interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 3, 2014 by Monk Rowe, director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the jazz archive room at Hamilton College, and I’m pleased to have Hide Tanaka here with me today, visiting with Junior Mance. Welcome.
